hook.say: Turkey's ten tallest dams, ranked. Number one towers over the Hoover Dam!

outro.say: Which dam have you seen in person? Comment below!

items.name: Artvin Dam
items.say: Number ten: Art-veen Dam, wedged into the Cho-rooh canyon. 180 meters.
items.cap: Number ten: Artvin Dam, wedged into the Çoruh canyon. 180 meters.

items.name: Oymapınar Dam
items.say: Nine: Oy-mah-pih-nar, a concrete arch above Mah-nahv-gaht. 185 meters.
items.cap: Nine: Oymapınar, a concrete arch above Manavgat. 185 meters.

items.name: Arkun Dam
items.fact: Hidden high in the Çoruh valley
items.say: Eight: Ar-koon, hidden high in the Cho-rooh valley. 188 meters.
items.cap: Eight: Arkun, hidden high in the Çoruh valley. 188 meters.

items.name: Boyabat Dam
items.fact: A concrete wall across the Kızılırmak
items.say: Seven: Boy-ah-baht, a concrete wall across the Kih-zil-ur-mahk. 195 meters.
items.cap: Seven: Boyabat, a concrete wall across the Kızılırmak. 195 meters.

items.name: Altınkaya Dam
items.say: Six: Al-tin-kah-yah, a mountain of rock, tied at 195 meters.
items.cap: Six: Altınkaya, a mountain of rock, tied at 195 meters.

items.name: Berke Dam
items.say: Five: Bair-keh, squeezed into a canyon on the Jay-hahn. 201 meters.
items.cap: Five: Berke, squeezed into a canyon on the Ceyhan. 201 meters.

items.name: Keban Dam
items.say: Four: Keh-bahn, the first giant on the Euphrates. 210 meters.
items.cap: Four: Keban, the first giant on the Euphrates. 210 meters.

items.name: Ermenek Dam
items.say: Three: Air-meh-nek, a razor-thin arch, also 210 meters.
items.cap: Three: Ermenek, a razor-thin arch, also 210 meters.

items.name: Deriner Dam
items.say: Two: Deh-ree-nair, Turkey's tallest for a decade. 249 meters.
items.cap: Two: Deriner, Turkey's tallest for a decade. 249 meters.

items.name: Yusufeli Dam
items.fact: 54 m taller than the Hoover Dam
items.say: And number one: Yoo-soo-feh-lee! 275 meters, 54 meters taller than the Hoover Dam.
items.cap: And number one: Yusufeli! 275 meters, 54 meters taller than the Hoover Dam.
